recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast studio portrait of a man in a dark blazer and open white shirt, holding a woven straw hat aloft, set against a bright blue background with large-scale, 3D-rendered primary color graphic elements behind him.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered with dynamic arm movement creating a diagonal line
Foreground subject layered over large geometric background shapes
High-contrast lighting casting sharp shadows on the subject's face and clothing
Clean white typography anchored to the top-left and bottom-left corners
coreInvariants: Primary red and yellow 3D graphic blocks
Woven straw texture of the hat

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot, centered subject occupying the middle 60% of the frame vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the raised straw hat create the primary focal points.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left text, moves down to the face, follows the arm up to the hat, and ends at the bottom-left text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Open blue space in the upper-left and upper-right quadrants provides breathing room for text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cerulean blue background providing a cool base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant red and yellow used for large background graphic elements.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for all typographic elements to ensure legibility.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background elements contrasted with the neutral tones of the subject's brown blazer and white shirt.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to primary colors plus brown and white

characterSpecificRedesigns: None; focus on clean, modern execution

composition.relationshipToImage: placed over background and subject edges

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family usage with varying weights and sizes for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Sharp drop shadows on the subject

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, modern, tech-adjacent aesthetic of the original.
Provides a similar geometric clarity and weight range.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man with curly hair in a brown blazer and open white shirt, holding a straw hat up. Background is bright blue with large 3D red and yellow block shapes. High contrast lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply bold white geometric sans-serif text in the top-left and bottom-left corners. Ensure text is flush left.

verificationChecks: Are the 3D shapes primary red and yellow?
Is the subject's arm creating a diagonal?

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the subject's face

postGenerationChecks: Check for 3D depth in background shapes
Verify straw texture on the hat
Ensure no text overlap with the subject's face
Confirm high-contrast shadow on the blazer
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast studio portrait with bold, primary-colored 3D geometric background elements and clean, white, corner-aligned sans-serif typography.
